Actual observe-mode main serves diagnostics/release plan but rejects new message ingress and leaves every threaded business-table row unchanged.
Actual index.ts refuses a future migration before listening or mutating the SQLite file; schema downgrade is never attempted.

limitations: No release member pack, real supplier or execute-mode release is configured in this main-entry smoke.
A preload guard redirects only data/sandbox paths and denies fetch; production startup, recovery order, routes and lifecycle are unchanged.
